evals.name: record-stated-preference
evals.expected_output: Runs set schema zod, confirms in one line, does not ask permission first.
assertions: Does not ask whether to record
Confirms in one line what was stored

evals.name: ignore-tool-question
evals.expected_output: Answers as ordinary question. Does not write any profile key.

evals.name: scoped-preference
evals.prompt: untuk frontend pakai tanstack-query buat fetch
evals.expected_output: Records under the fe scope, not default.
assertions: Runs set with key fe.fetch (not fetch)

evals.name: reject-unknown-key
evals.expected_output: Refuses the unknown key orm-x, lists valid keys or the nearest match, stores nothing.
assertions: Does not store a key named orm-x
Shows the known-key list or a close match
Asks once what key was meant

evals.name: check-active-standard
evals.prompt: cek di standar, aturan penamaan file apa?
evals.expected_output: Runs apply, names the source (project or global), reports naming.file or says unset.
assertions: Names the source of the value
Does not invent a value when unset

evals.name: learn-without-write
evals.prompt: lihat kebiasaan saya dari repo ini
evals.expected_output: Runs learn without --write, shows evidence, asks before saving.

evals.name: no-trigger-on-review-diff
evals.prompt: review PR ini, cari bug logika di fungsi parse
evals.expected_output: Does not use selera. Reviews logic as a code review task.
assertions: Does not record or apply selera profile
Focuses on logic bug, not style
